note: Every timestamp below is a real wall-clock reading from this session (Asia/Singapore, +08:00). The container's own logs print UTC, so the run logs in .tmp keep -8h; the two are the same instants. Five runs were needed: two were discarded (one because the plugin refused to load, one because a failing worker makes the `failed` shape outrank `rejected`), two are the blocked attempts that did not reach the state, and two produced the shots.

modelPins.why: the state wanted is a real recorded failure; this route is declared by the provider catalogue and really fails on this machine (no credential), so the child starts, ends failed, and the run keeps going
the blocked attempt needs children that really work and outlive the script's per-call budget, so the worker must be a live model
the rejected shape is checked only after every step has settled cleanly, so the workers had to succeed; a failing worker produces the `failed` line instead (that is what discarded run 20:38 showed)

in `layered` mode a rejected model draft falls back to the deterministic narrative, which passes the gate, so nothing is ever rejected and the event never fires. `model` is a documented value of the key and has no fallback; the gate itself is unchanged

the blocked hypothesis needs the script to give up on a running child while the run itself is never cancelled; a run deadline would have made the stop reason `cancelled`, which the panel deliberately does not call stuck
this plugin no longer reads `mode`; src/config.ts lists it among the removed keys

runs.result: the plugin REFUSED to load: 'roles.worker names model "opencode-go/no-such-model-stuck-hint", which provider "bifrost-responses" does not enumerate'. With the plugin inert, the conversation model answered with the core `workflow` tool instead, so the 进度 tab showed that engine run (起点 → 终点, run name `parallel-file-writes`, labels `write-notes`/`write-test`) and no stuck line. Not used as evidence; it is why the recipe now checks the boot log for a load error before driving a run.
runs.lesson: a bad model id cannot be used as a failure injector: config validation catches it before any run exists

runs.hypothesis: H1: give every child a 1 s call budget (childTimeoutMs 1000) with no run deadline (timeoutMs 0), so the script abandons a child that is still working and the run ends over a row it never settled
runs.prompt: 用 grok_workflow 工具跑一个工作流（只用 grok_workflow，不要用内置的 workflow 工具），拆成两个互相独立、可以并行的任务，每个任务都要真的写一个文件：任务一：在 notes.md 里写三行安装步骤；任务二：在 test.txt 里写一行 hello。两个任务并行跑，不要串行；跑完把每个任务做了什么汇总一下。
runs.observed: chip 已完成, stuckPresent false at both widths (21 nodes / 22 edges). The abandoned children kept running and their `agent-end` (completed) landed before the run closed, so every row settled and no node was ever blocked. Readings in readings-blocked-attempt1.json; stream in blocked-attempt1-session-stream.txt.

runs.hypothesis: H2: same, but a 30 s call budget and children that genuinely cannot finish in time (each task starts with `sleep 600`), so the run must end while two calls are still open
runs.prompt: 用 grok_workflow 工具跑一个工作流（只用 grok_workflow，不要用内置的 workflow 工具），拆成两个互相独立、可以并行的任务，每个任务都要真的写一个文件：任务一：先执行命令 sleep 600，等它睡够，再在 notes.md 里写三行安装步骤；任务二：先执行命令 sleep 600，等它睡够，再在 test.txt 里写一行 hello。两个任务并行跑，不要串行；跑完把每个任务做了什么汇总一下。
runs.observed: chip 未通过, stuckPresent false at both widths (9 nodes / 10 edges). The stream shows the mechanism: seq 1, 2 and 6 were still open when the run closed, and the host wrote `agent-end {seq 1, outcome: cancelled}`, `{seq 2, cancelled}`, `{seq 6, cancelled}` BEFORE `run-end {stopReason: error}`. Every row therefore settled, and a cancelled row is not a blocked node. Readings in readings-blocked-attempt2.json; stream in blocked-attempt2-session-stream.txt.
runs.conclusion: on this engine the teardown cancels outstanding children before it writes run-end, so the 'run ended over a row it never settled' shape does not survive to the page

runs.observed: the stuck line appeared, but as `卡在 2：执行 第 1 遍没过`: progressPanelStuck answers the `failed` question before the `rejected` one, and a run whose workers all failed has an unrecovered failed row
runs.lesson: rejected can only be reached by a run in which nothing failed, so the workers must be a live model
